tools.name: exec
tools.description:
Run JavaScript code to orchestrate/compose tool calls. All nested tools are available on the global `tools` object. Accepts raw JavaScript source text, not JSON or markdown.
### `apply_patch`
The apply_patch tool can edit files. This is a FREEFORM tool, so do not wrap the patch in JSON.
exec tool declaration:
declare const tools: { apply_patch(input: string): Promise<unknown>; };
### `exec_command`
declare const tools: { exec_command(args: { cmd: string; }): Promise<unknown>; };

input.content: Use apply_patch for file edits. Follow the actual tool declarations and their argument types.
Create outputs/probe.txt containing hello. Make one tool call and do not run tests.
